observations: I opened assets/panels/03-5.png, workflow/review/page-03.png, main-cast.png and checkin-patients.png with Read and looked at them.
A wall TV fills roughly the right third of the width and the top quarter of the height. It shows a plain light-teal screen with one wide, empty white strip and no drawn text or numbers.

From screen-left to screen-right, Mr. Raman, Priya and Ravi sit on blue waiting chairs. All three look up toward the TV with small satisfied smiles, and each matches their sheet (Raman's glasses, brows and cream shirt; Priya's ponytail, scrunchie, coral kurti and crossbody bag; Ravi's beard and green shirt).
Raman's hands match production: his right hand (screen-left) holds the stick upright beside his knee, and his left hand rests on his knee.
Priya's hands match production: her right hand rests near the armrest, and her left hand holds her phone in her lap.
Ravi's hands match production: his right hand holds his phone up, and his left hand, wearing the watch, rests on the shoulder bag on his lap.
Two background figures at left are small and unobtrusive. The phones show no readable screen content.
On page-03.png the caption sits on the empty upper-left wall, and the slot label is lettered inside the TV's white strip. No face, hand, phone, stick or bag is covered.
